name: RainTech Connect Webhooks
author: raintech357

sections.description:
RT Connect Webhooks provides a lightweight system for sending JSON POSTs to configured webhook endpoints when site events occur. Supports:

  • User Registration
  • Post Published
  • Post Updated
  • WooCommerce Order Created (if WooCommerce active)

Includes a simple admin interface under Settings > RT Connect Webhooks and basic logging.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure webhooks under Settings > RT Connect Webhooks.

short_description: Send webhooks for user registrations, post changes and WooCommerce orders. Extensible and ready for WordPress.org.
